---
title: "SLF Spatiotemporal Analysis"
format: html
---

## 1. Read Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| cache: false
library(INLA)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
#install.packages("terra")  # Run once if terra is not installed.
library(terra)

analysis_years <- 2020:2026
train_years <- 2020:2024
test_years <- 2025:2026
active_months <- 1:12
end_year <- 2026
end_month <- 7
analysis_crs <- 26918
cell_size_m <- 10000


all_occurrence_file <- "all_occurence_clean.csv"
roads_file <- "Highway.gpkg"
ndvi_dir <- "NDVI"


stopifnot(
  file.exists(all_occurrence_file),
  file.exists(roads_file),
  dir.exists(ndvi_dir)
)

# Read the cleaned data once. The source file and its columns are not modified.
df_all <- readr::read_csv(
  all_occurrence_file,
  col_select = c(year, month, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, species),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(
    year %in% analysis_years,
    month %in% active_months,
    year < end_year | (year == end_year & month <= end_month),
    !is.na(decimalLatitude), !is.na(decimalLongitude)
  )

# Select spotted lanternfly records from the in-memory full dataset.
df_slf <- df_all %>%
  filter(species == "Lycorma delicatula")

# Consecutive monthly index: January 2020 = 1, ..., July 2026 = 79.
add_time_index <- function(x) {
  x %>% mutate(
    time_idx = (year - min(analysis_years)) * length(active_months) +
      match(month, active_months)
  )
}
df_slf <- add_time_index(df_slf)
df_all <- add_time_index(df_all)
n_times <- (end_year - min(analysis_years)) * length(active_months) + end_month

slf_sf <- st_as_sf(df_slf, coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"),
                   crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>% st_transform(analysis_crs)
all_sf <- st_as_sf(df_all, coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"),
                   crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>% st_transform(analysis_crs)
roads_sf <- st_read(roads_file, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>% st_transform(analysis_crs)

```

## 2. Calculate

```{r}
# Use the full 2020-2026 observation footprint so train and test share a grid.
ny_grid <- st_make_grid(all_sf, cellsize = cell_size_m, square = TRUE) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number(), grid_area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 1e6)

effort_grid_time <- all_sf %>%
  st_join(ny_grid["grid_id"], left = FALSE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% count(grid_id, time_idx, name = "effort")

slf_grid_time <- slf_sf %>%
  st_join(ny_grid["grid_id"], left = FALSE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% count(grid_id, time_idx, name = "y")

# Road density (km of road per km2) in each grid cell.
roads_geometry <- st_sf(
  geometry = st_geometry(roads_sf),
  crs = st_crs(roads_sf)
)

roads_clipped <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(
  roads_geometry, ny_grid %>% select(grid_id)
))
road_cov <- roads_clipped %>%
  mutate(road_km = as.numeric(st_length(st_geometry(.))) / 1000) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% group_by(grid_id) %>%
  summarise(road_km = sum(road_km, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Monthly mean NDVI for each 10 km grid cell.
ndvi_index <- tidyr::crossing(
  year = analysis_years,
  month = active_months
) %>%
  filter(year < end_year | (year == end_year & month <= end_month)) %>%
  mutate(
    time_idx = (year - min(analysis_years)) * length(active_months) + month,
    file = file.path(
      ndvi_dir,
      sprintf("ndvi_%d_%02d.tif", year, month)
    )
  )

missing_ndvi <- ndvi_index$file[!file.exists(ndvi_index$file)]
if (length(missing_ndvi) > 0L) {
  stop("Missing NDVI files: ", paste(missing_ndvi, collapse = ", "))
}

ndvi_grid_time <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(ndvi_index)), function(i) {
  ndvi_raster <- terra::rast(ndvi_index$file[i])
  grid_for_raster <- terra::project(
    terra::vect(ny_grid),
    terra::crs(ndvi_raster)
  )
  ndvi_values <- terra::extract(
    ndvi_raster,
    grid_for_raster,
    fun = mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  tibble(
    grid_id = ny_grid$grid_id,
    time_idx = ndvi_index$time_idx[i],
    ndvi = ndvi_values[[2]]
  )
})

# Fill NDVI gaps caused by cloud/snow masks or state-boundary pixels.
interpolate_ndvi <- function(value, time) {
  valid <- is.finite(value) & value > -999
  if (sum(valid) < 2L) return(value)
  approx(
    x = time[valid],
    y = value[valid],
    xout = time,
    method = "linear",
    rule = 2
  )$y
}

ndvi_grid_time <- ndvi_grid_time %>%
  mutate(ndvi = if_else(is.finite(ndvi) & ndvi > -999, ndvi, NA_real_)) %>%
  group_by(grid_id) %>%
  arrange(time_idx, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(ndvi = interpolate_ndvi(ndvi, time_idx)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(time_idx) %>%
  mutate(ndvi = replace_na(ndvi, median(ndvi, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup()


centre_coords <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(ny_grid))
grid_attributes <- ny_grid %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(grid_id, grid_area_km2,
            x = centre_coords[, 1], y_coord = centre_coords[, 2]) %>%
  left_join(road_cov, by = "grid_id") %>%

  mutate(
    road_km = replace_na(road_km, 0),
    road_density = road_km / grid_area_km2

  ) %>%
  select(grid_id, x, y_coord, road_density)


model_df <- tidyr::crossing(
  grid_id = ny_grid$grid_id,
  time_idx = seq_len(n_times)
) %>%
  mutate(
    year = analysis_years[(time_idx - 1L) %/% length(active_months) + 1L],
    month = active_months[(time_idx - 1L) %% length(active_months) + 1L]
  ) %>%
  left_join(effort_grid_time, by = c("grid_id", "time_idx")) %>%
  left_join(slf_grid_time, by = c("grid_id", "time_idx")) %>%
  left_join(grid_attributes, by = "grid_id") %>%
  left_join(ndvi_grid_time, by = c("grid_id", "time_idx")) %>%
  mutate(effort = replace_na(effort, 0L), y = replace_na(y, 0L)) %>%
  filter(effort > 0)

if (anyNA(model_df$ndvi)) {
  stop(
    "NDVI remains missing for ", sum(is.na(model_df$ndvi)),
    " model rows after temporal and spatial-median imputation."
  )
}

# Standardize using training data only, preventing information leakage.
train_rows <- model_df$year %in% train_years
scale_from_train <- function(z, train) {
  s <- sd(z[train], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(s) || s == 0) stop("A predictor has zero training variance.")
  (z - mean(z[train], na.rm = TRUE)) / s
}
model_df <- model_df %>% mutate(
  road_z = scale_from_train(road_density, train_rows),
  ndvi_z = scale_from_train(ndvi, train_rows),
  year_idx = year - min(analysis_years) + 1L,
  month_idx = month
)

cat("Training units:", sum(train_rows), "\n")
cat("Test units:", sum(!train_rows), "\n")
cat("Training zero proportion:", mean(model_df$y[train_rows] == 0), "\n")
```

## 3. Mesh and SPDE

```{r}
#| cache: false
#| fig-cap: "INLA mesh"
coords <- as.matrix(model_df[, c("x", "y_coord")])
mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(
  loc = coords, 
  max.edge = c(15000, 50000),
  cutoff = 8000, 
  offset = c(15000, 40000))
spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
  mesh = mesh, prior.range = c(50000, 0.5), prior.sigma = c(1, 0.01)
)
A <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = coords)
spde_idx <- inla.spde.make.index("spatial.field", n.spde = mesh$n)
plot(mesh); points(coords, col = "steelblue", pch = 20, cex = 0.25)
```

## 4. Train & Predict

```{r}
#| cache: true
# Test responses are hidden from INLA and used only after prediction.
y_stack <- model_df$y
y_stack[!train_rows] <- NA_integer_

stk <- inla.stack(
  data = list(y = y_stack),
  A = list(A, 1),
  effects = list(
    spde_idx,
    data.frame(
      intercept = 1,
      year_idx = model_df$year_idx,
      month_idx = model_df$month_idx,
      road_z = model_df$road_z,
      ndvi_z = model_df$ndvi_z
    )
  ),
  tag = "all"
)

result <- inla(
  y ~ -1 + intercept + road_z + ndvi_z +

    f(year_idx, model = "rw1", constr = TRUE) +
    f(month_idx, model = "rw2", cyclic = TRUE, constr = TRUE) +
    f(spatial.field, model = spde),
  family = "poisson",
  data = inla.stack.data(stk),
  E = model_df$effort,
  control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stk), compute = TRUE,
                           link = rep(1L, nrow(model_df))),
  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
  verbose = TRUE
)
saveRDS(result, "model_2020_2024_forecast_2025_2026.rds")
summary(result)
```

## 5. Review

```{r}
#| cache: true
# With `control.predictor$A`, INLA returns both:
#   fitted.APredictor = values projected through inla.stack.A(stk), and
#   fitted.Predictor  = the internal predictor/latent rows.
# Only APredictor rows correspond one-to-one, and in order, with `model_df`.
fitted_all <- result$summary.fitted.values

if (is.null(fitted_all) || nrow(fitted_all) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "`result$summary.fitted.values` is empty. Re-run Section 4 with ",
    "`control.predictor = list(..., compute = TRUE)` before Section 5."
  )
}

apredictor_rows <- startsWith(
  rownames(fitted_all),
  "fitted.APredictor."
)
fitted_summary <- fitted_all[apredictor_rows, , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(fitted_summary) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No fitted.APredictor rows were found in the INLA result. ",
    "Check rownames(result$summary.fitted.values)."
  )
}

if (nrow(fitted_summary) != nrow(model_df)) {
  stop(
    "Prediction-row mismatch: INLA returned ", nrow(fitted_summary),
    " APredictor rows, but model_df contains ", nrow(model_df), " rows. ",
    "Re-run Sections 2-4 in order so that model_df, stk, and result match."
  )
}

# APredictor is the expected SLF rate per unit of observation effort.
# Convert rates to expected SLF counts using the Poisson exposure.
model_df$pred_rate <- fitted_summary$mean
model_df$pred_rate_q025 <- fitted_summary$`0.025quant`
model_df$pred_rate_q975 <- fitted_summary$`0.975quant`

model_df$pred_mean <- model_df$pred_rate * model_df$effort
model_df$pred_q025 <- model_df$pred_rate_q025 * model_df$effort
model_df$pred_q975 <- model_df$pred_rate_q975 * model_df$effort

test_predictions <- model_df %>%
  filter(year %in% test_years) %>%
  mutate(covered_95 = y >= pred_q025 & y <= pred_q975)

test_metrics <- test_predictions %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    observed_positive_cells = n_distinct(grid_id[y > 0]),
    observed_total = sum(y), predicted_total = sum(pred_mean),
    MAE = mean(abs(y - pred_mean)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((y - pred_mean)^2)),
    poisson_deviance = 2 * mean(if_else(
      y == 0, pred_mean, y * log(y / pred_mean) - (y - pred_mean)
    )),
    interval_coverage_95 = mean(covered_95), .groups = "drop"
  )
print(test_metrics)
readr::write_csv(test_predictions, "predictions_2025_2026.csv")
readr::write_csv(test_metrics, "test_metrics_2025_2026.csv")

annual_compare <- test_predictions %>%
  group_by(grid_id, year) %>%
  summarise(observed = sum(y), predicted = sum(pred_mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(observed, predicted), names_to = "type", values_to = "count") %>%
  left_join(ny_grid %>% select(grid_id), by = "grid_id") %>% st_as_sf()

p1<-ggplot(annual_compare) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = log1p(count)), color = NA) +
  facet_grid(year ~ type) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "log(1 + count)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Observed and out-of-sample predicted SLF counts")

p2<-ggplot(test_predictions, aes(y, pred_mean, color = factor(year))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log1p") + scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
  labs(x = "Observed", y = "Predicted", color = "Year") + theme_minimal()

print(p1)
print(p2)

ggsave("map.png", plot = p1, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("point_chart.png", plot = p2, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

## 6 Cell-level

```{r}
#| cache: true
# Aggregate monthly predictions to one record per 10 km grid cell and year.
cell_year_predictions <- model_df %>%
  group_by(grid_id, year) %>%
  summarise(
    observed_count = sum(y),
    predicted_count = sum(pred_mean),
    effort = sum(effort),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    observed_presence = observed_count > 0,
    presence_prob = 1 - exp(-predicted_count)
  )

# Select the highest-precision threshold that retains at least 90% recall
# using training years only. Test years are not used to choose the threshold.
threshold_candidates <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.001)
training_thresholds <- purrr::map_dfr(threshold_candidates, function(threshold) {
  d <- cell_year_predictions %>% filter(year %in% train_years)
  predicted <- d$presence_prob >= threshold
  tp <- sum(predicted & d$observed_presence)
  fp <- sum(predicted & !d$observed_presence)
  fn <- sum(!predicted & d$observed_presence)
  tibble(
    threshold = threshold,
    recall = ifelse(tp + fn > 0, tp / (tp + fn), NA_real_),
    precision = ifelse(tp + fp > 0, tp / (tp + fp), NA_real_)
  )
})

eligible_thresholds <- training_thresholds %>%
  filter(recall >= 0.90, is.finite(precision))
if (nrow(eligible_thresholds) == 0L) {
  stop("No presence threshold achieved 90% training recall.")
}
presence_threshold <- eligible_thresholds %>%
  arrange(desc(precision), desc(threshold)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(threshold)
cat("Presence threshold selected from training data:", presence_threshold, "\n")

# Standardized inverse-frequency weights estimated from training cell-years.
# Each observed class contributes 50% of the total evaluation weight.
training_positive_rate <- cell_year_predictions %>%
  filter(year %in% train_years) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(observed_presence)) %>%
  pull(rate)

weight_positive <- 1 / (2 * training_positive_rate)
weight_negative <- 1 / (2 * (1 - training_positive_rate))
cat(
  "Training positive rate:", training_positive_rate,
  "\nPositive weight:", weight_positive,
  "\nNegative weight:", weight_negative, "\n"
)

test_cell_year <- cell_year_predictions %>%
  filter(year %in% test_years) %>%
  mutate(predicted_presence = presence_prob >= presence_threshold)

# Confusion-matrix counts and imbalance-aware classification metrics.
cell_confusion_metrics <- test_cell_year %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    TP = sum(predicted_presence & observed_presence),
    FN = sum(!predicted_presence & observed_presence),
    FP = sum(predicted_presence & !observed_presence),
    TN = sum(!predicted_presence & !observed_presence),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    recall = TP / (TP + FN),
    precision = TP / (TP + FP),
    specificity = TN / (TN + FP),
    accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + FN + FP + TN),
    weighted_accuracy =
      (weight_positive * TP + weight_negative * TN) /
      (weight_positive * (TP + FN) + weight_negative * (TN + FP)),
    balanced_accuracy = (recall + specificity) / 2,
    F1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall),
    F2 = 5 * precision * recall / (4 * precision + recall)
  )
print(cell_confusion_metrics)

# Publication-ready confusion matrices showing annual cell counts.
confusion_plot_data <- test_cell_year %>%
  transmute(
    year,
    Observed = factor(
      if_else(observed_presence, "Present", "Absent"),
      levels = c("Present", "Absent")
    ),
    Predicted = factor(
      if_else(predicted_presence, "Present", "Absent"),
      levels = c("Absent", "Present")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(year, Observed, Predicted, .drop = FALSE, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    label = format(n, big.mark = ","),
    dark_cell = n >= 0.45 * max(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

confusion_matrix_plot <- ggplot(
  confusion_plot_data,
  aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, fill = n)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label, color = dark_cell),
    size = 4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~year, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "#f7fbff", "#deebf7", "#c6dbef", "#9ecae1",
      "#6baed6", "#3182bd", "#08519c", "#08306b"
    ),
    name = "Cell count",
    labels = scales::label_comma()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "black"),
                     guide = "none") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "Observed", y = "Predicted") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.5, "lines")
  )

print(confusion_matrix_plot)
ggsave(
  "confusion_matrix_2025_2026.tiff",
  confusion_matrix_plot,
  width = 7, height = 3.6, units = "in",
  dpi = 600, compression = "lzw"
)
ggsave(
  "confusion_matrix_2025_2026.png",
  confusion_matrix_plot,
  width = 7, height = 3.6, units = "in",
  dpi = 600, bg = "white"
)

# Average precision (PR-AUC summary) calculated separately by test year.
average_precision <- function(observed, probability) {
  ord <- order(probability, decreasing = TRUE)
  observed <- observed[ord]
  if (sum(observed) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  precision_at_rank <- cumsum(observed) / seq_along(observed)
  mean(precision_at_rank[observed])
}
cell_pr_auc <- test_cell_year %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    PR_AUC = average_precision(observed_presence, presence_prob),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(cell_pr_auc)

# Count accuracy only among cells where SLF was actually observed.
positive_cell_errors <- test_cell_year %>%
  filter(observed_presence) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    positive_cells = n(),
    MAE_positive = mean(abs(observed_count - predicted_count)),
    RMSE_positive = sqrt(mean((observed_count - predicted_count)^2)),
    mean_bias_positive = mean(predicted_count - observed_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(positive_cell_errors)

# Recall of the strongest 10% of observed-positive hotspots.
hotspot_recall <- test_cell_year %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    positive <- .x %>% filter(observed_presence)
    k <- max(1L, ceiling(0.10 * nrow(positive)))
    observed_hotspots <- positive %>%
      slice_max(observed_count, n = k, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(grid_id)
    predicted_hotspots <- .x %>%
      slice_max(predicted_count, n = k, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(grid_id)
    tibble(
      hotspot_cells = k,
      top_10pct_hotspot_recall = mean(observed_hotspots %in% predicted_hotspots)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
print(hotspot_recall)

# Cell-level bias map. Positive values indicate overprediction.
cell_bias_map <- test_cell_year %>%
  mutate(bias = predicted_count - observed_count) %>%
  left_join(ny_grid %>% select(grid_id), by = "grid_id") %>%
  st_as_sf()

# Outer boundary of all grid cells included in the analysis.
study_boundary <- ny_grid %>%
  filter(grid_id %in% cell_year_predictions$grid_id) %>%
  summarise()

cell_bias<-ggplot(cell_bias_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = bias), color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(
    data = study_boundary,
    fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.45,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Predicted - observed"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Annual cell-level prediction bias")
ggsave("cell_bias.png", plot = cell_bias, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

readr::write_csv(test_cell_year, "cell_level_predictions_2025_2026.csv")
readr::write_csv(cell_confusion_metrics, "cell_confusion_metrics_2025_2026.csv")
readr::write_csv(confusion_plot_data, "confusion_matrix_counts_2025_2026.csv")
readr::write_csv(positive_cell_errors, "positive_cell_errors_2025_2026.csv")
readr::write_csv(hotspot_recall, "hotspot_recall_2025_2026.csv")
```
